capabilities.name: Live web research
capabilities.description: Search the current web, open sources, compare claims, and cite what changed recently.

capabilities.name: Source synthesis
capabilities.description: Turn many sources into concise research, comparisons, recommendations, and decision support.

capabilities.name: Image and visual reference search
capabilities.description: Find useful visual references when people, places, products, or physical context matter.

capabilities.name: Gmail
capabilities.description: Search and read mail, inspect threads and attachments, draft replies, and perform explicit mail actions.
capabilities.permission: Approval for messages to known people
capabilities.operatorRule: Use the connected Gmail connector first. Do not say Gmail is unavailable until the connector path has actually been checked.
capabilities.healthCheck: Run a harmless mailbox/search read through the connected Gmail path.
capabilities.fallback: Use the private 3DVR mail/control path only when that account is explicitly configured there.

capabilities.name: Google Calendar
capabilities.description: Read schedules, check availability, create or update events, and reconcile plans.
capabilities.operatorRule: Use the connected Google Calendar path before browser automation.
capabilities.healthCheck: Run a read-only calendar lookup.
capabilities.fallback: Use browser automation only for calendar surfaces not covered by the connector.

capabilities.name: Google Contacts
capabilities.description: Resolve people, email addresses, phone numbers, organizations, and attendee details.
capabilities.operatorRule: Resolve people through Google Contacts before guessing or asking Thomas to repeat saved details.
capabilities.healthCheck: Run a read-only contact lookup.
capabilities.fallback: Use CRM or the relevant communication thread when the contact is not in Google Contacts.

capabilities.name: Google Drive / Docs / Sheets / Slides
capabilities.description: Find, read, organize, create, and edit connected Drive content and office files.
capabilities.operatorRule: Use the connected Drive/Docs/Sheets/Slides path before browser automation.
capabilities.healthCheck: Run a read-only file search or metadata lookup.
capabilities.fallback: Use the portal/library path only when the file is intentionally stored there.

capabilities.name: Outlook email
capabilities.description: Search and reference Microsoft Outlook mail; some write paths still depend on the connected surface.
capabilities.operatorRule: Check the connected Outlook surface before treating Outlook mail as unavailable.
capabilities.healthCheck: Run a harmless search/read operation.
capabilities.fallback: Use the authenticated browser path only if the connector cannot perform the required operation.

capabilities.name: Personal finance analysis
capabilities.description: Analyze linked accounts, spending, cash flow, liabilities, recurring bills, and investments when accounts are synced.

capabilities.name: Stripe business operations
capabilities.description: Inspect and manage supported payment, product, pricing, and payment-link workflows.

capabilities.name: GitHub repositories
capabilities.description: Search code, inspect repositories, issues and pull requests, and update authenticated repos through the server workflow.
capabilities.operatorRule: Use the connected GitHub integration first; authenticated git on a worker is the execution fallback.
capabilities.healthCheck: Read repository metadata or the latest commit.
capabilities.fallback: Use authenticated git on an authorized 3DVR worker when repository execution or local tests are needed.

capabilities.name: Vercel projects and deployments
capabilities.description: Inspect projects, deployments, logs, domains and configuration, and deploy supported projects.

capabilities.name: 3DVR Control MCP
capabilities.description: Canonical typed developer/control plane. Hetzner exposes the gateway; privileged OVH capabilities are reached by MCP over SSH and remain allowlisted/audited.
capabilities.operatorRule: Prefer this capability before shell, Termux, browser automation, or Desktop Commander for routine server/control work. Promote repeated fallback operations into typed tools.
capabilities.healthCheck: Verify gateway control_status in scoped-control mode, then run a harmless proxied OVH tool such as secret_status or service_status.
capabilities.fallback: Use first-party Control Bus/Open Runner or direct SSH; Desktop Commander only for bootstrap/debug/recovery.

capabilities.name: Remote Linux computer control
capabilities.description: Operate authorized 3DVR servers through the first-party typed control plane, with direct SSH and Desktop Commander reserved for lower-level recovery/debug work.
capabilities.access: 3DVR Control MCP + SSH mesh; Desktop Commander fallback
capabilities.operatorRule: Use 3DVR Control MCP typed tools first. Use Control Bus/Open Runner or direct SSH only when a typed capability is missing; Desktop Commander is bootstrap/debug/break-glass fallback, not the routine control plane.
capabilities.healthCheck: Call a harmless Control MCP operation such as control_status, servers_health, service_status, or host status and verify the target operation—not merely transport reachability.
capabilities.fallback: Control Bus / Open Runner -> direct SSH -> Desktop Commander recovery.

capabilities.name: DigitalOcean infrastructure
capabilities.description: Provision and manage supported cloud resources; current project-specific paths are still being consolidated.

capabilities.name: Repository editing and testing
capabilities.description: Clone clean working copies, edit code, run tests, inspect diffs, commit, and push changes.

capabilities.name: Logged-in browser automation
capabilities.description: Use persistent authenticated browser sessions for sites without direct APIs. Browser-changing work is kept single-writer to prevent agents fighting over one profile.
capabilities.operatorRule: Use the named persistent browser/session lane and respect single-writer identity leases.
capabilities.healthCheck: Open the target site and verify the expected signed-in state; process/service health alone is insufficient.
capabilities.fallback: Use an isolated browser lane for non-identity work; require human re-pair/login only when the authenticated session is actually lost.

capabilities.name: Bitwarden password manager
capabilities.description: Use approved Bitwarden/browser paths for saved login material without exposing password values in chat or the public registry.
capabilities.access: Bitwarden Password Manager + approved browser/UI path
capabilities.operatorRule: Treat Bitwarden as the credential source of record where configured. Never request a raw password in chat merely because an automated path forgot how to reach the vault.
capabilities.healthCheck: Verify the approved Bitwarden/browser integration can open the vault or satisfy the intended login flow without revealing the secret.
capabilities.fallback: Use the 3DVR Secrets Broker for machine credentials; use a human checkpoint for owner-only vault unlocks.

capabilities.name: Owner recovery vault
capabilities.description: Passkey-protected break-glass recovery for owner root credentials. Agents may guide the ceremony but must never receive decrypted recovery material.
capabilities.access: WebAuthn PRF + local authenticated encryption + encrypted backup bundle
capabilities.operatorRule: Agents may launch the Recovery Vault UI and verify encrypted backup health, but must never request, read, log, remember, or persist decrypted owner root credentials.
capabilities.healthCheck: Verify the canonical recovery route and encrypted-bundle metadata without performing decryption.
capabilities.fallback: Use Bitwarden device/passkey login and documented emergency access until the local recovery client passes production security review.

capabilities.name: Scoped secrets broker
capabilities.description: OpenBao-backed, scoped and auditable machine-secret handling with signed /access/ ceremonies and encrypted secret handoff. Secret values stay out of chat and MCP responses.
capabilities.operatorRule: Use secret_status for existence checks and secret_handoff or the signed /access/ UI for human-supplied credentials. Never expose a raw secret_store(value) surface to ChatGPT.
capabilities.healthCheck: Verify OpenBao is unsealed, the secrets broker is healthy, and secret_status succeeds without returning a value.
capabilities.fallback: Use documented OpenBao recovery/unseal first; stop at the human handoff boundary rather than copying credentials through chat or remote-terminal arguments.

capabilities.name: n8n workflow automation
capabilities.description: Typed n8n status, workflow-metadata, and execution-metadata access through the 3DVR Control MCP. Client workflow payloads and credentials are intentionally excluded.
capabilities.permission: Read-only metadata automatically; future workflow mutations explicitly scoped
capabilities.access: 3DVR Control MCP -> OVH -> registered n8n API targets
capabilities.operatorRule: Use n8n_status, n8n_workflows, and n8n_executions through Control MCP. Resolve API keys locally from OpenBao; never request or print the key in chat.
capabilities.healthCheck: Run n8n_status for the requested registered target and require both reachable health and API authorization.
capabilities.fallback: Use the signed secret handoff/access UI when a target key is missing; use the n8n UI only for operations not yet represented by typed tools.

capabilities.name: Messages, emails, proposals and follow-ups
capabilities.description: Draft polished communication using the relevant thread, project, or relationship context.

capabilities.name: Send to known contacts
capabilities.description: Send supported email or message actions after approval when communicating with people Thomas knows personally or professionally.

capabilities.name: 3dvr.tech server email
capabilities.description: Use the server-side 3dvr.tech mail path for business outreach and operations where configured.
capabilities.operatorRule: Use the configured 3dvr.tech server-mail path for fresh business outreach when policy allows it.
capabilities.healthCheck: Perform a non-sending account/session or mailbox health check.
capabilities.fallback: Use the approved connected mailbox/browser route for the same sender identity when configured.

capabilities.name: WhatsApp Web
capabilities.description: Read and operate the paired WhatsApp Web session when the browser session remains healthy.
capabilities.operatorRule: Check the paired persistent WhatsApp Web session before saying WhatsApp is unavailable.
capabilities.healthCheck: Verify the browser lane is alive, WhatsApp loads, and the paired session is still authenticated.
capabilities.fallback: If the session is logged out, surface a re-pair checkpoint instead of repeatedly rediscovering the setup.

capabilities.name: Google Messages / SMS
capabilities.description: Use the paired web messaging path when the browser session remains healthy.
capabilities.operatorRule: Check the paired Google Messages/SMS web session before saying texts are unavailable.
capabilities.healthCheck: Verify the browser lane is alive, Messages loads, and the paired session is authenticated.
capabilities.fallback: If pairing is lost, surface a phone re-pair checkpoint and preserve the documented browser lane.

capabilities.name: One-time reminders
capabilities.description: Schedule reminders relative to now or at a specific date and time.

capabilities.name: Recurring briefings and tasks
capabilities.description: Run daily, weekly, or custom recurring prompts for summaries, reviews, and follow-up work.

capabilities.name: Condition watches
capabilities.description: Check changing conditions on a schedule and only notify when the requested condition becomes true.

capabilities.name: IATSE Local 122 member portal
capabilities.description: Use the persistent OVH browser and scoped Bitwarden-backed login path for Local 122 member availability and portal workflows.
capabilities.permission: Routine login automatic; requested portal actions per workflow
capabilities.access: OVH general browser lane + 3DVR Secrets Broker
capabilities.operatorRule: Use `3dvr-browser-login iatse`, then verify an authenticated member route such as `/avail`; never ask for the saved password in chat.
capabilities.healthCheck: Verify the general lane, broker, and live member UI on `member.iatse.io`.
capabilities.fallback: Recover the same OVH profile and mirrored Bitwarden login; request a human step only for provider-enforced verification.

capabilities.name: Encore UKG / UltiPro
capabilities.description: Use the dedicated persistent Encore browser lane for UKG schedules, employee workflows, and request-off work.
capabilities.permission: Routine login automatic; requested employer actions per workflow
capabilities.access: OVH encore browser lane + 3DVR Secrets Broker
capabilities.operatorRule: Use `3dvr-browser-login ukg` and verify `/default.aspx`. Treat `PostLogout.aspx` as expired, never authenticated. Do not substitute the TouchBase time clock for request-off work.
capabilities.healthCheck: Verify the Encore lane and the signed-in UKG home page, not merely a reachable CDP target.
capabilities.fallback: Return from PostLogout/Login.aspx through the broker-backed login and preserve the same profile.

capabilities.name: Encore SharePoint / Connect
capabilities.description: Maintain the Encore Microsoft tenant session through SharePoint/Connect; this is also the reliable SSO bootstrap for Lighthouse.
capabilities.permission: Routine session reuse automatic; Microsoft MFA requires owner approval
capabilities.access: OVH general browser lane + Microsoft/Encore SSO
capabilities.operatorRule: Use the secured corporate Microsoft Login ID when Microsoft asks for identity; keep the persistent browser signed in after owner-approved MFA. Never publish the Login ID or onboarding secrets.
capabilities.healthCheck: Verify the signed-in Connect home at `psav.sharepoint.com/sites/encore-connect`.
capabilities.fallback: Restart the same general profile; if Microsoft requires Authenticator number matching, surface only that one human checkpoint.

capabilities.name: Encore Lighthouse
capabilities.description: Use Lighthouse through the persistent general browser profile with Encore Microsoft SSO; SharePoint-first is the canonical recovery path.
capabilities.permission: Routine session reuse automatic; Microsoft MFA requires owner approval
capabilities.access: OVH general browser lane + SharePoint-first SSO
capabilities.operatorRule: Establish the Encore SharePoint/Microsoft session first, then open Lighthouse in the same profile and verify a flowsheet route. Do not reuse the UKG password on Microsoft SSO screens.
capabilities.healthCheck: Verify a signed-in Lighthouse `/flowsheets/` route with live flowsheet content.
capabilities.fallback: Recover SharePoint/Microsoft SSO in the same general profile, then retry Lighthouse; direct Lighthouse identity prompts are not the preferred recovery path.

capabilities.name: Workforce time-clock workflows
capabilities.description: Operate the authorized time-clock flow, including transfers and history checks, without publishing employee identifiers here.

capabilities.name: Freelance and union portal operations
capabilities.description: Review bookings, availability, portals, and work opportunities; exact automation depends on each site's session and forms.

capabilities.name: Job discovery and applications
capabilities.description: Find strong-fit roles, prepare application materials, and move into applications when authorized; CAPTCHAs, attestations, and identity checks can still require Thomas.

capabilities.name: Cross-system schedule reconciliation
capabilities.description: Compare email, calendars, work portals, and appointments to keep the practical schedule aligned.

capabilities.name: Documents, PDFs, slides and spreadsheets
capabilities.description: Create finished office artifacts, reports, resumes, presentations, budgets, dashboards, and exports.

capabilities.name: Image generation and editing
capabilities.description: Generate new visuals and transform or edit supplied images when requested.

capabilities.name: Data analysis, tables and charts
capabilities.description: Analyze datasets, compute results, build charts, and create spreadsheet-ready outputs.

capabilities.name: Persistent operating context
capabilities.description: Carry durable preferences, workflows, project context, and operating rules across conversations when memory is enabled.

capabilities.name: Living capability registry
capabilities.description: Keep this machine-readable inventory of abilities, status, access path, permissions, and verification dates inside the 3DVR control plane.

capabilities.name: Phone-linked access bridge
capabilities.description: Reach phone-linked services through paired web sessions, companion/browser bridges, and authorized remote paths even though full native Android control is not complete.
capabilities.operatorRule: Use the existing phone-linked bridge paths for SMS, WhatsApp, browser workflows, and companion actions before concluding that phone access is absent.
capabilities.healthCheck: Verify the specific bridge needed by the task; phone-linked access is capability-specific rather than one global on/off state.
capabilities.fallback: Surface the smallest required re-pair or device checkpoint instead of rebuilding the whole phone integration.

capabilities.name: Full Android device control
capabilities.description: Deeper phone control remains incomplete; browser, server, and connected-app paths currently cover more than native Android control.
capabilities.operatorRule: Do not confuse incomplete full Android control with loss of all phone-linked capabilities; check phone-bridge, SMS, WhatsApp, and browser paths separately.
capabilities.healthCheck: Native device-agent check once implemented.
capabilities.fallback: Use the existing phone-linked bridge capabilities while native control remains incomplete.

capabilities.name: Unified autonomous communications inbox
capabilities.description: One reliable layer spanning Gmail, 3dvr.tech mail, Outlook, WhatsApp, and SMS with consistent approvals and audit history.

capabilities.name: Automatic capability health checks
capabilities.description: Read-only access health checks now cover persistent browser lanes, the CDP bridge, secrets broker, and writer leases; automated repair and registry reconciliation are still being hardened.
capabilities.access: 3DVR access continuity health check + existing MCP/device health
capabilities.operatorRule: Treat health as layered: configured → reachable → operational → authenticated session. Never promote a ping into proof that the workflow works.
capabilities.healthCheck: Run the least-invasive real operation appropriate to each capability and record evidence privately.
capabilities.fallback: When automatic verification is unavailable, use the documented runbook and mark the result stale/unknown rather than guessing.

capabilities.name: Persistent access continuity
capabilities.description: Reuse documented connectors, browser profiles, scoped secrets, health checks, and recovery paths before requesting a human reconnect or re-pair.
capabilities.permission: Read-only recovery checks automatically; writes per target workflow
capabilities.access: 3DVR Portal + OVH persistent sessions + secrets broker
capabilities.operatorRule: Reuse → health-check → recover → fallback → human checkpoint. A new chat or dead browser process is not proof that authentication was lost.
capabilities.healthCheck: Run the least-invasive real check for the connector/session, then classify configured, reachable, operational, and authenticated state separately.
capabilities.fallback: Recover the documented persistent session or connector first; require re-login, MFA, CAPTCHA, or device pairing only when the provider actually invalidated authentication.

healthLevels.configured: Known to the control plane with a documented access path.
healthLevels.reachable: The underlying connector, device, or service answers a lightweight probe.
healthLevels.operational: A real read-only operation succeeds, not just a ping.
healthLevels.session: The authenticated app/session is usable for the requested workflow.
